## Change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue when one exists.

## Verification

List the focused checks and required gates run, with their results. Explain any remaining
limitations. Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oscarvasquezroncal/cuanta/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for the Git workflow and exact commands.

- [ ] Scope, strict typing and hexagonal layers are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass without weakened assertions or budgets.
- [ ] User-visible text is covered in English and Spanish where applicable.
- [ ] Changed external contracts and public behavior are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, client details or local plans are included.
